description: Lists the caller's OWN YAFL transfers only — metadata only (id, size, status, expiry, and a download path). Never returns file contents, never a decrypted name, and never another account's files. Optionally cap the number of results with `limit`.

limit.description: Maximum number of transfers to return (most recent first). Omit for the full capped list.

name: list_files
title: List Files
